## Experience

### Alibaba Group

<div class="paper-meta">Customer Operations Department | Research Scientist | Academic Research Collaboration | Hangzhou, China | July 2022 - Present</div>

- Conduct embedded research on human-AI service system design, workforce management, and AI-enabled customer operations.
- Collaborate with operational teams to design and evaluate field interventions using large-scale operational data, field experimentation, and causal inference.
- Translate operational challenges into research questions and feasible empirical designs.

**Research relevance:** This collaboration supports my research on AI-enabled customer service operations, human-AI collaboration, workforce management, and platform operations.

:::

::: {.paper-entry}
### Environmental Defense Fund and LONGi Green Energy

<div class="paper-meta">Climate Corps Fellow | Xi'an, China | July 2021 - Oct. 2021</div>

- Analyzed supplier carbon-management challenges and benchmarked green supply-chain practices.
- Developed a supplier empowerment roadmap covering training, renewable-energy adoption, monitoring, and incentives.

**Research relevance:** This experience is related to operational problem diagnosis, supplier-side analysis, benchmarking, and implementation-oriented sustainability work.

## Research Connection

These roles help ground my academic work in operational settings where technology, workers, customers, and organizations interact. The Alibaba collaboration is most directly connected to my current agenda on AI-enabled service operations and platform operations. The EDF Climate Corps and LONGi experience adds broader exposure to supplier-side operational analysis and sustainability-oriented process improvement.
